forbidden.name: packages-cannot-import-apps
forbidden.comment: Workspace packages must not depend on application entry points.

forbidden.name: shared-cannot-import-modules
forbidden.comment: Shared packages must remain independent of business modules.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-cannot-import-modules
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure packages must not depend on business modules.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-cannot-import-apps
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure packages must not depend on application entry points.

forbidden.name: modules-cannot-import-apps
forbidden.comment: Business modules must not depend on application entry points.

forbidden.name: identity-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Identity must not depend on other business modules.

forbidden.name: authorization-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Authorization may depend only on Identity.

forbidden.name: business-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Business may depend only on Identity.

forbidden.name: branch-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Branch may depend only on Business.

forbidden.name: staff-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Staff may depend only on Business and Branch.

forbidden.name: customer-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Customer may depend only on Business and Identity.

forbidden.name: service-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Service may depend only on Business and Branch.

forbidden.name: appointment-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Appointment may depend only on Customer, Staff, Service and Branch.

forbidden.name: payment-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Payment may depend only on Appointment.

forbidden.name: review-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Review may depend only on Appointment and Customer.

forbidden.name: marketplace-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Marketplace may depend only on Business, Branch, Staff, Service and Review.

forbidden.name: inventory-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Inventory may depend only on Business and Branch.

forbidden.name: notification-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Notification may depend only on Identity.

forbidden.name: media-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Media must not depend on business modules.

forbidden.name: audit-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Audit must not directly depend on business modules.

forbidden.name: api-cannot-depend-on-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: API must communicate through the Application layer only.

forbidden.name: api-cannot-depend-on-domain
forbidden.comment: API must not bypass the Application layer.

forbidden.name: application-cannot-depend-on-api
forbidden.comment: Application must not depend on the API layer.

forbidden.name: application-cannot-depend-on-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Application depends on abstractions, never infrastructure implementations.

forbidden.name: domain-cannot-depend-on-api
forbidden.comment: Domain must remain framework independent.

forbidden.name: domain-cannot-depend-on-application
forbidden.comment: Domain must not know about use cases.

forbidden.name: domain-cannot-depend-on-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Domain must remain independent of persistence and external systems.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-cannot-depend-on-api
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure must never depend on HTTP.

forbidden.name: no-importing-module-api
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import another module's API layer directly.

forbidden.name: no-importing-module-application
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import another module's Application layer.

forbidden.name: no-importing-module-domain
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import another module's Domain layer.

forbidden.name: no-importing-module-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import another module's Infrastructure layer.

forbidden.name: modules-cannot-access-other-module-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Modules must not access another module's persistence or infrastructure.

forbidden.name: modules-cannot-access-other-module-repositories
forbidden.comment: Repositories are private to their owning module.

forbidden.name: modules-cannot-access-other-module-database
forbidden.comment: Business modules must never access another module's database implementation.

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: This dependency is part of a circular relationship. You might want to revise your solution (i.e. use dependency inversion, make sure the modules have a single responsibility)

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: This is an orphan module - it's likely not used (anymore?). Either use it or remove it. If it's logical this module is an orphan (i.e. it's a config file), add an exception for it in your dependency-cruiser configuration. By default this rule does not scrutinize dot-files (e.g. .eslintrc.js), TypeScript declaration files (.d.ts), tsconfig.json and some of the babel and webpack configs.

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core
forbidden.comment: A module depends on a node core module that has been deprecated. Find an alternative - these are bound to exist - node doesn't deprecate lightly.

forbidden.name: not-to-deprecated
forbidden.comment: This module uses a (version of an) npm module that has been deprecated. Either upgrade to a later version of that module, or find an alternative. Deprecated modules are a security risk.

forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package that isn't in the 'dependencies' section of your package.json. That's problematic as the package either (1) won't be available on live (2 - worse) will be available on live with an non-guaranteed version. Fix it by adding the package to the dependencies in your package.json.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: This module depends on a module that cannot be found ('resolved to disk'). If it's an npm module: add it to your package.json. In all other cases you likely already know what to do.

forbidden.name: no-duplicate-dep-types
forbidden.comment: Likely this module depends on an external ('npm') package that occurs more than once in your package.json i.e. bot as a devDependencies and in dependencies. This will cause maintenance problems later on.

forbidden.name: not-to-spec
forbidden.comment: This module depends on a spec (test) file. The responsibility of a spec file is to test code. If there's something in a spec that's of use to other modules, it doesn't have that single responsibility anymore. Factor it out into (e.g.) a separate utility/ helper or a mock.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package from the 'devDependencies' section of your package.json. It looks like something that ships to production, though. To prevent problems with npm packages that aren't there on production declare it (only!) in the 'dependencies'section of your package.json. If this module is development only - add it to the from.pathNot re of the not-to-dev-dep rule in the dependency-cruiser configuration

forbidden.name: optional-deps-used
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package that is declared as an optional dependency in your package.json. As this makes sense in limited situations only, it's flagged here. If you use an optional dependency here by design - add an exception to yourdependency-cruiser configuration.

forbidden.name: peer-deps-used
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package that is declared as a peer dependency in your package.json. This makes sense if your package is e.g. a plugin, but in other cases - maybe not so much. If the use of a peer dependency is intentional add an exception to your dependency-cruiser configuration.
